description: Defines constants, structures, and function prototypes for Bluetooth Attribute Protocol (ATT) handling in Zephyr OS, including MTU negotiation, attribute requests, and EATT support.

methods.name: bt_att_get_mtu
methods.description: Retrieves the MTU for a given Bluetooth connection.

methods.name: bt_att_create_pdu
methods.description: Creates a Protocol Data Unit (PDU) for ATT communication.

methods.name: bt_att_req_alloc
methods.description: Allocates a new ATT request with a specified timeout.

methods.name: bt_att_req_free
methods.description: Frees a previously allocated ATT request.

methods.name: bt_att_send
methods.description: Sends an ATT Protocol Data Unit over a connection.

methods.name: bt_att_req_send
methods.description: Sends an ATT request over a connection.

methods.name: bt_att_find_req_by_user_data
methods.description: Finds a pending ATT request by its user data pointer.

methods.name: bt_att_fixed_chan_only
methods.description: Checks if only the fixed ATT channel is connected.

methods.name: bt_att_clear_out_of_sync_sent
methods.description: Clears the out-of-sync flag on all channels.

methods.name: bt_att_out_of_sync_sent_on_fixed
methods.description: Checks if an out-of-sync error has been sent on the fixed ATT channel.

methods.name: bt_att_set_tx_meta_data
methods.description: Sets transmission metadata for a buffer.

methods.name: bt_att_increment_tx_meta_data_attr_count
methods.description: Increments attribute count in transmission metadata.

methods.name: bt_att_tx_meta_data_match
methods.description: Checks if transmission metadata matches given parameters.

methods.name: bt_att_chan_opt_valid
methods.description: Validates channel options for a connection.

methods.name: bt_gatt_req_set_mtu
methods.description: Sets the MTU for a GATT request.
